name: Account dropdown: one caret box in both states — stop the +5.38px width jump, keep the R8 caret reading
outcome: The account frame's caret is one ▾ in both states, flipped by a layout-neutral transform pivoting on the glyph's ink centre when open — the frame is pixel-equal across the toggle (261.28px, one distinct value over 15 readings) in dev and the local production build, where the +5.38px jump used to be
